heading: Helix is for every team shipping AI code.
description: From solo founders to enterprise platform teams, Helix gives every role a predictable, verifiable workflow for AI-driven development.

items.title: Move fast without breaking things.
items.description: Atomic PRs keep main green and your weekends quiet.
outcomes: Fewer late-night hotfixes from sprawling AI diffs.

items.title: Ship features, not diffs.
items.description: Stop reviewing 2,000-line AI PRs and focus on the change that matters.
outcomes: Every unit passes types, tests, and lint.

items.title: Predictable AI delivery.
items.description: Plan features, not vibes — and tell stakeholders what shipped and why.

items.title: Governance, by construction.
